declarations.name: AuiDateRangePicker
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI DateRangePicker: `<aui-date-range-picker>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Visible group label and accessible name of the role=group around both fields.

inputs.name: startLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the start field (visually hidden). Default: localized 'Start date'.

inputs.name: endLabel
inputs.description: Accessible name of the end field (visually hidden). Default: localized 'End date'.

inputs.name: min
inputs.description: Inclusive lower bound for both dates (validation and calendar).

inputs.name: max
inputs.description: Inclusive upper bound for both dates (validation and calendar).

inputs.name: minDays
inputs.description: Minimum range length in days, counting the start and end day (integer 1-100000).

inputs.name: maxDays
inputs.description: Maximum range length in days, counting the start and end day (integer 1-100000).

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name; Form and the hidden input carry the ISO 8601 interval YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD.

inputs.name: startName
inputs.description: Field name of the start date's own hidden input (YYYY-MM-DD) for native form posts.

inputs.name: endName
inputs.description: Field name of the end date's own hidden input (YYYY-MM-DD) for native form posts.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text referenced by the group's aria-describedby.

inputs.name: required
inputs.description: Both dates are required (value-missing).

inputs.name: disabled
inputs.description: Disables both fields and the calendar button; a disabled picker is not submitted.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Prevents editing; the calendar button is disabled.

inputs.name: isDateDisabled
inputs.description: Disable days in the calendar; a typed disabled start or end day is invalid ('date-unavailable'). Days between the ends are not checked.

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Business calendar (since 0.9.0): non-working days and holidays are marked and named in the calendar.

inputs.name: disableNonWorking
inputs.description: With businessCalendar: non-working days cannot be picked or typed (since 0.9.0).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation, run when the field and range constraints pass; return a message to mark the value invalid (error 'custom').

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: First calendar column (ISO weekday). Default: the locale's first day of week.

inputs.name: icons
inputs.description: Icon slot overrides.

inputs.name: closeOnSelect
inputs.description: Close the popup after the last day of the range is picked.

inputs.name: months
inputs.description: Months in the popup. 'auto': two when the viewport is at least 40rem wide when the popup opens, else one. Applied on the next open.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Segment order, calendar, messages, formatting; forwarded to all children.

inputs.name: timezone
inputs.description: Zone used only to determine today in the calendar.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Arrow-key mirroring, calendar direction, and popup alignment.

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: User typing or a completed calendar pick changed the value or validity. Dispatched from the picker host; the inner Date Input and Calendar change events are not exposed.

outputs.name: navigate
outputs.description: Bubbles from the inner Calendar when the user changes the visible months; month is the first visible month.

properties.name: isOpen
properties.description: Read-only: Whether the popup is open.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open the calendar on the range start (else the typed start date, else today) and focus it. No-op when disabled or read-only.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Close the calendar; an unfinished pick is discarded. Focus inside the popup returns to the calendar button.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show both fields' messages now and return validity.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: External error (server, cross-field rule), shown on the end field; cleared when the user changes either date. null or '' clears it.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: ISO 8601 interval YYYY-MM-DD/YYYY-MM-DD, or null when there is no valid range.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the first segment of the start date.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Close, restore the initial range, and clear the custom error and touched/submitted state (no aui-change).

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Date Picker Dialog, non-modal variant, for a range: a labelled role=group containing two labelled segmented date fields (Date Input), a button with aria-haspopup=dialog inside the end field, and a role=dialog popup containing a range-selecting Calendar grid (one or two months).

limitations: Gregorian calendar only; years 1-9999 (Date Input range).
A range may include disabled days: isDateDisabled is checked on the start and end days only.
minDays and maxDays count both the start and the end day.
Validation messages follow Date Input timing (incomplete, required, and range or custom messages after the field is touched or on reportValidity); validationTiming is not supported.
validity reports one error at a time; a range error is shown on the field it concerns.
Closing the popup with only the first day picked discards that pick; the previous range stays.
No Cancel/OK buttons: picking the last day commits the range.
Screen-reader behavior has not yet been manually verified with NVDA, JAWS, and VoiceOver.
